description.value: Ramification Cellars is an estate winery on the shores of Vaseux Lake near Penticton, producing wines exclusively from grapes grown on their own property with a focus on ecological stewardship of the Okanagan Valley. The winery offers tastings, a wine club, and event hosting in a scenic lakeside setting, making it a natural stop on the Okanagan wine route. Cyclists riding the area will find a tasting room with on-site washrooms and parking.

address.value: 3500 BC-97, Okanagan Falls, BC V0H 1R0, Canada
